answer: Cipher-Linked Coordination Windows. Each agent action must carry a cipher chaining it to the prior action of a randomly assigned peer, forming an unbroken provenance chain. A missing link voids the whole chain, so fresh identities cannot start cleanly; each must inherit a chain or pay copper to anchor a new one at a fixed rate. The rate scales with chain depth, making parallel identity trees costly. An opal token marks verified chain roots, and roots without one are throttled.
